thought.text: The `pkill -f "nx"` matched its own shell command and killed itself. Let me be more careful with specific process names.

reasoning_content: The command was forcibly terminated by pkill -f "nx". Because the terminal command itself contains "nx" in its string (pkill -f matches against the entire command line, and since the shell's command line contains "nx"), it ended up killing itself. We need to be more careful and use a more specific pattern, or use a different approach.

action.command: ps aux | grep -iE "node|java|nx" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2, $11, $12, $13}' | head -20
